<thought>Based on the 13C NMR (carbonyl at ~167 ppm, two sp² carbons at ~144 ppm and ~130 ppm, and several aliphatic carbons) and the mass spectrum showing a molecular ion at m/z 141.115 (likely [M+H]⁺), the neutral molecular weight is about 140.107 Da. The formula that best matches this mass and the NMR pattern is C₈H₁₂O₂ (exact mass 140.0837 Da). A plausible structure consistent with these data is methyl cyclohex‑2‑ene‑1‑carboxylate, whose SMILES is **COC(=O)C1=CCCCC1**. This SMILES accounts for the carbonyl, the conjugated alkene, and the aliphatic ring carbons observed in the spectra.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(=O)C1=CCCCC1</final_answer>
